title: Crop/Canopy Owner-State Readiness and Minimal Lifecycle Boundary
purpose: Determine the minimal authoritative crop-owned state needed to feed the qualified F-WOF17 root-geometry producer and F-WOF18 reference-ET transpiration producer, classify reconstructible values so they do not become duplicate persistent state, and fail closed if the current admitted lineage does not yet contain a transactional crop lifecycle host.

option_dependent_committed_root_state.note: WRT may also be needed by the crop model independently of root-depth mode; F-WOF19 only classifies the dependency required by the qualified root-geometry path.

reconstructible_not_commit_authority.rooted_nodes: derived by F-WOF16 from current root depth and immutable grid geometry
reconstructible_not_commit_authority.cumulative_root_fraction_nonadaptive: derived by F-WOF16 from current root depth and immutable root-profile parameters
reconstructible_not_commit_authority.potential_transpiration: current ET process result produced by F-WOF18, not crop state

current_nonpersistent_inputs.fco2tra: current crop-response factor; B1.10 co2_effect(2) sets 1 when CO2 correction is inactive or derives it from selected CO2 concentration and CO2TRATB when active
current_nonpersistent_inputs.selected_reference_ET: forcing owned outside crop state and consumed by F-WOF18

transaction_requirements: crop emergence/harvest/lifecycle transitions must be trial-safe; rejected trials may not advance the committed lifecycle
DVS, LAI and any option-dependent committed root state used by a trial must originate from the correct committed checkpoint
reconstructible vcover, CF, rooted_nodes, cumulative root fraction and ptra must never become independent commit authorities
replay from the same committed crop state and forcing must reproduce the same owner views
no calendar-derived lifecycle mutation may be hidden inside F-WOF17, F-WOF18 or runtime adapters
allowed_result_of_this_workunit: blocked status with an explicit crop-host release condition
forbidden: inventing committed crop state in runtime
persisting vcover, CF, rooted_nodes, cumulative root fraction or ptra merely because legacy globals saved them
blindly merging the diverged F-WOF04 through F-WOF10 lineage
implementing daily crop lifecycle scheduling in this readiness unit
assuming one kernel interval equals one day
making F-WOF17 or F-WOF18 own crop lifecycle state
moving legacy crop-file I/O into the kernel
release_condition: A subsequent F-WOF owner unit must provide a source-bound transactional crop lifecycle host or committed read-only crop-state authority for crop_emerged, DVS, LAI and the option-dependent root state required by the selected root-depth mode. Only then may these values be composed into F-WOF17/F-WOF18 and downstream F-WOF13.
